_doc: city-art r15/r16b — the sky panorama manifest (game/world/art/sky/README.md). `active` names the plate mc_sky blends in as its cloud field; `sun_az_deg` is the plate's own sun azimuth measured off the file by tmp/city-art/r15/rgbe.py; `ref` is its median luminance, which becomes the shader's `pano_ref` so only the plate's STRUCTURE is taken and its exposure never fights the dome's. An index file, not a directory scan: the shipped .app has no tests/ and no DirAccess walk (see the export-safety rule).
